name: PLSC 3990
title: Field Study Internship
description: Students will work with professionals in an area of research or management. Students taking this course will be assigned a final grade of S (satisfactory) or U (unsatisfactory.) This course may be repeated provided that the sum total of credits earned does not exceed six credits. Formerly offered as SPSS 3990. May be repeated for a total of 6 credits.
requirement_description: Open only to juniors and seniors who have demonstrated professional potential as identified by their advisor.
